headline: Small but clean SE with offshore afternoon — fun little log session.
today: 1.8ft SE at a good angle, and the wind cooperates: light W dawn, cross-off morning, straight offshore W in the afternoon and evening. Nothing big but it'll be clean and rideable all day, best in the afternoon once the W offshore sets up. Log or groveler.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest swell of the week, SE to 3.7ft at a good angle with S wind only cross here, not straight onshore like the LI beaches. The pick of the week for size — fish or shortboard, worth the drive.
2.7ft SSE with light SW cross-off winds all day. Shorter period and fair angle but clean and surfable — solid backup to Thursday.
Chest-high SE at a good angle under N cross winds. Clean-ish, another fun option if you're already out this way.
